title: Overseer
description: Manage Discord servers with natural language. An AI agent that understands your commands and executes moderation, roles, and server management automatically.
longDescription: Overseer is an autonomous AI-driven Discord bot built to streamline community moderation and administration. Instead of memorizing slash commands, server administrators and moderators can converse with Overseer using natural language. It interprets user intent, validates permissions, and performs administrative actions like assigning roles, kicking or muting rule-breakers, and configuring channels.
features: Natural language intent parsing with LLM integration
Automated moderation and context-aware action triggers
Granular permission validation before executing sensitive server actions
Persistent audit log and event history tracking

title: Bubble
description: Discord-powered AI engine generator with persistent memory and custom training support. Build your own AI persona that lives in your Discord server.
longDescription: Bubble lets communities create and nurture unique AI personas within Discord. Each Bubble persona can maintain long-term memory across chat conversations, adapt its tone and knowledge base through custom prompt engineering, and interact naturally with community members across multiple channels.
features: Long-term memory persistence across conversation threads
Custom system prompt configuration for distinct personas
Context window optimization to preserve chat history efficiently
Server-specific roleplay and knowledge base customization

title: Hungerfall
description: A text-based adventure game with an AI-Narrator that adapts the story to your choices. Every playthrough is unique.
longDescription: Hungerfall transforms traditional Discord text games into a dynamic, AI-mastered RPG adventure. Players embark on survival quests where the dungeon master / narrator generates original storyline twists, encounters, and challenges in real time, reacting dynamically to player decisions and inventory management.
features: Dynamic AI-driven story generation reacting to player choices
Turn-based survival mechanics with inventory and health stats
Multiplayer party decisions and voting mechanism
Branching storylines with procedural world building

title: mustacho.dev
description: Personal developer portfolio and interactive showcase built with Next.js, React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.
longDescription: mustacho.dev is the official personal website and portfolio for Mustacho. Crafted with Next.js App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Motion (Framer), it features dynamic theme switching, an interactive retro canvas, categorized project showcases, interconnected technical skill graphs, and a developer blog.
features: Dynamic theming engine with multiple custom retro & modern palettes
Interactive retro canvas, pixel art mustache icon, and sound effects
Interconnected Skills and Projects exploration graph
Markdown-powered developer blog with syntax highlighting and reading time
Responsive, accessible design optimized for performance and SEO

title: celebimiz.com.tr
description: An interactive map application showcasing historical locations, travel routes, and rich contextual notes sourced from Evliya Çelebi's Seyahatnâme.
longDescription: celebimiz.com.tr is an interactive web platform designed to map and bring to life the historical landmarks, travel itineraries, and cultural stops documented in Ottoman explorer Evliya Çelebi's renowned 10-volume travelogue, the Seyahatnâme. Users can explore historical locations across an interactive map interface, read contextual excerpts, and trace the journeys of the 17th-century traveller.
features: Interactive map visualization of historical stops and landmarks from the Seyahatnâme
Detailed historical context, excerpts, and localized travel documentation for each location
Intuitive map controls, category filtering, and route exploration tools
Responsive, fluid web interface optimized for both desktop and mobile devices

title: Recast
description: An offline, privacy-first file converter desktop application built with Tauri. Convert images and WebP files seamlessly without uploading online.
longDescription: Recast is a high-performance, native desktop application engineered with Tauri and Rust. It gives creators and developers an instant, 100% offline way to batch convert images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF) without sacrificing quality or uploading private media to third-party web services.
features: 100% offline processing for complete privacy
Multi-threaded batch conversion powered by Rust
WebP, PNG, JPEG, and modern image format optimization
Minimal CPU and RAM footprint via Tauri lightweight architecture

title: Pearl
description: A lightweight, modern desktop productivity tool designed for speed, custom workflows, and offline-first performance.
longDescription: Pearl is an elegant personal command center and productivity companion built with Tauri and React. Focused on speed, clean minimalism, and zero bloat, Pearl assists daily developer routines with quick-access utilities, custom macro workflows, and offline-first notes.
features: Snappy global shortcut access and clean overlay UI
Customizable workflow shortcuts and macro automation
Local encrypted storage for offline notes and configuration
Tailored dark mode interface adhering to system themes
